description: Retrieve the full details of a single listing by its hashid. Returns the complete ListingResource projection including parcel data, all attribute details, and attachments. Broker contact is included only when the requesting user is authorised.

hashid.description: The short hashid of the listing (e.g. "a1b2c3d4"). Found in listing URLs and search hits.
